items.label: SUMMER GAMES
items.why: the boot program: loads at $02A7 over the BASIC vectors so it runs as it loads, then loads SGLOAD

items.label: LOADER
items.problem: the chain from (175, 173) loops or leaves the disk
items.why: not a whole file: three sectors of track 23 and then a chain that leaves the disk; the NTSC image boots through it, a protection decoy on the PAL image

items.label: L
items.why: a packed character screen for $C400-$CC07; the engine's letter table (module_letters, $0AF3) names it as module 11, but the menus only ever run modules 0 to 10, so nothing loads it

items.label: M
items.why: a second copy of L's screen with other colours; its letter is not in module_letters ($0AF3), the only source of the names the engine loads, and no boot file names it

items.label: B
items.why: the engine, packed; unpacked to $0C00-$3EFF

items.label: DEFAULT
items.why: the factory world records, in WR's layout: SGLOAD's boot code at $C0EB tries to load WR twice and loads DEFAULT to $0B00 only when both fail

items.label: E
items.why: platform diving, packed; unpacked to $5800-$BBFF

items.label: A
items.why: the opening ceremony and menus, packed; unpacked by load_module ($0934) to $4000-$7F99

items.label: F
items.why: the 4x400 m relay and 100 m dash, packed; unpacked to $4000-$7FEF

items.label: K
items.why: skeet shooting, packed; unpacked to $4000-$7CEF

items.label: H
items.why: the gymnastics vault, packed; unpacked to $4000-$BF11

items.label: SGLOAD
items.why: the PAL boot loader: copies a fast loader to $C000 and the engine's loader stub to $0900-$0BFF, then loads A and B

items.label: D
items.why: pole vault, packed; unpacked to $4000-$CAFF

items.label: I
items.why: freestyle relay and 100 m freestyle, packed; unpacked to $1000-$BEFF over the engine

items.label: WR
items.why: the world records the game saves: loaded to $0B00 at boot by SGLOAD ($C11B) and written back by save_records ($1563) after a new record

items.label: track 17, sector 1
items.why: sectors no file holds: every load is by file name (the boot files, then module_letters at $0AF3), and the only block read in the game is the protection's U1 of track 35, sector 1 ($3B69 in the engine)
